about: Judging models per tool (docs/development.md, 'Judging models'). The rubric is the product; the judging model is a replaceable part. Each tool lists preferred model families in order; 'match' is the exact pattern of a family's model ids (it excludes tier variants such as -mini); 'checked' lists the exact versions that passed the fixed test set, with the date and where the result is written down. The program picks, per tool: the newest checked version that is available, then a newer unchecked version of a preferred family, then the CLI's own default model. --model overrides it. Updated by hand only (no network fetch).
